title: SWIFT MT103 Message Duplication — Outbound Wire Transfer Double-Send

content.summary: A retry-storm in the SWIFT message broker caused 38 outbound MT103 wire transfer messages to be submitted twice to the SWIFT network during a scheduled maintenance window on 2024-02-03. Duplicate payments totalling GBP 4.2 M were initiated before the duplicate-detection safeguard identified the anomaly.

timeline.event: Planned maintenance: SWIFT gateway failover to DR node initiated
Primary node handoff completes; DR node begins processing message queue
DR node detects 38 messages with status PENDING_ACK from primary and re-submits them
Automated duplicate-detection alerts: transaction-ledger sees 38 UETR collisions
P1 declared; wire-transfer-service pause flag activated
All duplicate payments recalled via SWIFT gpi; balances corrected

content.root_cause: The SWIFT gateway's DR node lacked access to the shared idempotency store (Redis cluster in primary DC) during failover due to a network ACL that blocked cross-DC Redis traffic. Without idempotency checks, the DR node treated 38 messages still in PENDING_ACK status as unacknowledged and re-submitted them. The idempotency store is documented as a required dependency in ARCH-004 but the DR runbook (RUN-006) did not include a pre-failover connectivity check.
contributing_factors: DR runbook missing Redis connectivity pre-check (gap identified in DR-test-2023-Q4 but not remediated)
SWIFT gateway DR node had no read access to the idempotency store during cross-DC failover
Duplicate-detection alert threshold set to 5 collisions; 38 occurred before human intervention

impact.customer_impact: 38 corporate customers experienced temporary double-debit; corrected within 2 hours

immediate: Issue SWIFT gpi recall for all 38 duplicate MTs
short_term: Add cross-DC Redis replication for idempotency store (JIRA PAY-9001)
Update DR runbook RUN-006 with Redis connectivity pre-check (JIRA OPS-2210)
Lower duplicate-detection threshold from 5 to 1 collision (JIRA PAY-9002)
long_term: Implement active-active Redis across DCs for idempotency store
Quarterly DR failover drill with idempotency store validation
Automated DR readiness gate in failover pipeline
